UK Nationalist Leaders Sign Cooperation Agreement, Eyeing Constitutional Change

Leaders from Scotland, Wales, and Northern Ireland signed a joint cooperation agreement in Cardiff, declaring that "Westminster's time is coming to an end." The summit, attended by the first ministers of these devolved nations, aimed to set the UK's Celtic nations on a path toward independence and constitutional change. Nationalist leaders presented the agreement as a significant step for their respective regions.
